title: Family chore tracker
name: chores
prompt: A chore tracker for our family of four. I (the owner) and my partner set chores and who does them each week; the kids see their own chores and tick them off. Each done chore earns points, and there is a weekly leaderboard. The kids should not be able to create or reassign chores.

answers: My partner and I are managers, the kids are members. Weeks start on Monday.
Points: 1 to 5 per chore, we choose when creating it.

edits: Let managers mark a chore as recurring every week so it is re-created automatically on Monday.
Show each kid a history of their last four weeks of points.
Add a 'swap request': a kid can ask to swap a chore with a sibling, and a manager approves or declines it.
